description: This event will fire when a player is finishing consuming an item (food, potion, milk bucket). If the ItemStack is modified the server will use the effects of the new item and not remove the original one from the player's inventory. If the event is cancelled the effect will not be applied and the item will not be removed from the player's inventory.
